notes:
Original acquisition terminal miss recorded at texts/21ae3ca30ea09cd7c1aecb17.miss (DOI, Unpaywall, OpenAlex, and archive routes unsuccessful); no original statistics copied from secondary reproduced F&K columns. Replication coefficient is printed, while a coefficient-specific t/z test statistic is not printed; parenthesized numbers are Newey-West standard errors, not test statistics. J-test chi-square and p-values test instrument validity and are not the target coefficient test. P threshold follows the coefficient significance stars and the printed two-sided legend; no exact p-value is printed. Reported success records the author’s explicit paper-wide verdict, not a coefficient-specific inferred verdict. Tables 6–8 captions say Equation (6), while their income-augmented variables and p. 10 identify the augmented model (Equation (7)).
Source follow-up: Original-only extraction from the published article. Requested test statistic is not printed for this individual coefficient: Table 5 prints the regression coefficient and Newey–West standard error (0.270); no t statistic was calculated. Coefficient retained as printed. No individual coefficient p value is printed; an unstarred coefficient was not converted into a numerical p bound. Sample size 12 denotes countries explicitly used in the regression panel, not a derived analytic country-year count. Input page locators refer to PDF pagination; the augmented model is Table 5(1).
